scope.summary: Stage C advisory change-aware validation with conservative full-browser fallback; required checks remain unchanged.
implemented: Changed-file test selector with conservative fallback.

criteria.description: Required PR checks finish substantially faster (target 3–8 minutes for Fast CI, 5–15 minutes for targeted where feasible); capture measured p50/p95.
Every PR still enforces evidence/governance, unit/lint/build, database migration/SQL integrity, authentication/authorization and tenant isolation requirements.
Changes touching relevant sensitive areas trigger corresponding targeted browser/integration coverage; no untrusted opt-out.
Nightly full regression runs once daily with an explicit time-zone strategy, artifacts and clear failure notifications.
A manual/full release-candidate regression verifies the exact commit before Beta release.
Required status checks, branch protection, merge queue and automatic merge/agent dispatch rules are updated atomically, with no merge-gate gap.
Existing full PR checks remain in place until replacement fast and full workflows are proven; rollback is documented.
Measured post-change validation shows no material loss of critical safety coverage and useful failure diagnostics.

tests.command: Validate change-aware selector and PR CI
tests.result: Fresh GitHub validation is pending after evidence correction.

decisions: Keep required verify and database checks unchanged.
This is an advisory trial only, with no merge or release authorization.
limitations: Targeted browser test coverage and CI duration not yet verified.
The first automated rerun raced PR description updates and was not valid evidence of a code failure.
blockers: CI validation and required security review pending.
